definitions.explanation: The larger group in a division of opinion, votes, or affiliation. Used in politics, group dynamics, and general discussions about which side has more support.

examples.japanese: {多数派|たすうは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}った→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多数派|たすうは}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}めている→占める：11799_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: The ruling party holds the majority in the parliament.

examples.japanese: {多数派|たすうは}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{属|ぞく}していなくて→属する：12402_zokusuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to hold firm to your own opinion even if you don't belong to the majority.

notes:
{多数派|たすうは} is a compound of ⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧ (many, majority) and ⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ (faction, group).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多数派|たすうは}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}める→占める：11799_shimeru⟧: to hold the majority
- {多数派|たすうは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: majority opinion
- {多数派|たすうは}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{属|ぞく}する→属する：12402_zokusuru⟧: to belong to the majority
- {多数派|たすうは}⟦{工作|こうさく}→工作：12437_kousaku⟧: majority-building maneuvering (political)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{少数派|しょうすうは}→少数派：12492_shousuuha⟧: minority, minority faction

REGISTER:
Common in political, social, and academic discussions. In everyday conversation, ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧ or ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧ might be used instead.
